heard: Astronomers tracked a deep space object heading straight for Earth. The body measured approximately 3 feet across. It swung past the moon every 23 days. Density estimates showed it was lighter than solid rock. Scientists realized it was a hollow, discarded rocket tank. It struck the atmosphere at nearly 25,000 miles per hour. Clouds in Sri Lanka blocked the daytime fireball, so researchers flew in a chartered jet to record the burn. They turned forgotten trash into a drill for an object heading straight for Earth.
